summary.title: The Well Rounded Engineer
summary.one_liner: A talk framing good software engineering as resting on individual technical ability and collaboration, with a roster of skills and concrete steps to improve each.
keywords: how to become a better software engineer
what makes a good software engineer
takeaways: Good software engineering rests on two pillars: individual technical ability and collaborating with others.
The talk focuses on individual technical skill and the foundation beneath a pyramid of skills.
It presents a roster of abilities, each with one or two concrete steps to make progress.
The roster is aimed mainly at engineers building modern web-based systems.
summary.summary: This is a talk page (Speaker Deck, dated February 13, 2019) by Swanand Pagnis titled The Well Rounded Engineer. It argues that doing a software engineering job well depends on two pillars: individual technical ability and working with others. The talk focuses on deconstructing individual technical skill, presenting a roster of abilities with one or two concrete steps for progress in each. The roster is aimed primarily at engineers who build modern web-based systems. The page text does not list the specific skills or steps.
